architecture.decision: Replace recursive DFS cycle detection with iterative Tarjan strongly connected components, guard semantic lookups against unhashable non-scalar field values, enforce bounded regular-file O_NOFOLLOW JSON/digest reads plus NaN/Infinity and JSON depth rejection, and keep all modules comfortably under 500 lines.

nonGoals: No schema or diagnostic code additions.
delivery.outcome: Exact iterative SCC cycle diagnostics without missed multi-branch cycles or false cross-SCC bridge findings, zero TypeError/RecursionError crashes on malformed inputs, bounded regular-file I/O, and sub-500-line modules.

validation.evidence: Unit and adversarial hardening tests plus ruff lint pass cleanly.
Governance and Wellman checks pass with 0 errors.

summary: Harden SCC cycle detection, unhashable field guards, and bounded JSON I/O
